slides.title: What Happened Monday, Nov 23
slides.body: Nvidia shares jumped about 31% after its board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO. Chip and AI stocks led the biggest one-day gain for US stocks since April 2025.

slides.title: The Numbers: Monday's Close
slides.subtitle: One-day change, Nov 23 (%)
slides.body: The S&P 500 closed at 7,237.17, up from 6,910.39 on Friday.

slides.title: Why It Matters
slides.body: Deutsche Bank's Jim Reid said similar volatility shocks have often taken 6 to 8 weeks to settle. Nvidia is still about 30% below its Oct 6 record.
